action_summary: Seventh answer to 'know all of our capabilities and say who wins at each'. Two things this round does that passes 1-6 did not. (1) Re-runs all eleven true-capability specs on OS_URANDOM seeds the author cannot choose: 5,500 instances, 5,500 passes, 0 model imports, 0 network. (2) Executes the front door on ten ordinary sentences and measures what a person actually gets, which passes 1-6 never did. Measured: at mode AUTO every one of the ten goals fails closed, and the execution envelope names the cause: BoundExecutionError:RENDERED_BOUND_ACTION_CAPABILITY_ID_MISMATCH for file.copy.v1 - the adapter renders the resolved capability id and then rejects it. The same goals pass only when a different route (raw-goal compiler) fires instead. Separately: a whole-tree AST census on today's merge gives 6,521 python files, 2,448 runtime modules, 18,441 runtime functions (pass 6 measured 2,238/16,155 on 2026-11-25); verifier 38/38 at digest b9a782c3. The comparison table is anchored to frontier numbers read from the live boards on 2026-11-26 rather than to FRONTIER_CAPABILITY_SURFACE_NORMALIZED_V1 (2026-09-28), which understates the frontier on at least three rows - ARC-AGI-3 7.78% there vs 81.2% on the ARC Prize board today.

recursive_obs.required_capability: A binding that preserves capability identity from route to render to adapter to receipt, and a comparison method that re-reads the frontier it is comparing against.
recursive_obs.stop_condition: Stop once the document exists, the intent passes orientation, drift and load-bearing checks, the referee is green, and no capability, ownership, family or terminal credit has changed.
recursive_obs.why_selected_route_is_fastest_sufficient: It is the only route that changes an answer. Another artefact count would produce an eighth nearly-identical document; executing the front door produced a defect that is one repair wide and blocks everything the other eight passes measured.

truth.the_law_this_round_adds: A COMPARISON IS ONLY AS CURRENT AS THE REFERENCE IT MEASURES AGAINST, AND A CAPABILITY NOBODY CAN ASK FOR IS A MEASUREMENT OF CODE, NOT OF CAPABILITY. Six censuses compared artefacts to a four-week-old frontier snapshot and never once executed the front door; the answer they produced was right about the artefacts and wrong about the machine.
what_is_false_in_the_claim_that_we_know_: that enumerating artefacts answers the question: 2,448 modules, 18,441 functions and 742 public-runner receipts still do not tell you what happens when a person types a sentence, and the sentance test took 30 seconds and found a defect
that the routed capability is the executed capability: the id resolves in 4-11 ms and is then rejected by the adapter that was handed it
that the stored frontier reference is current: it is 59 days old and wrong by up to 73 points
that a capability measurement transfers to a user path: file.copy.v1 passes 500/500 on unseen seeds and fails at the front door
that 'all of them' is available: the sixth pass established that the artefact that would make it available, TRUE_CAPABILITY_AUDIT, declines to audit about 2,200 modules
